name: commercial-promotion-pricing-controls
objective: Close omitted commercial/subscription/onboarding, promotion funding and pricing finance paths with exact money, trusted scope/source evidence, canonical accounting, idempotency and audit.
truthOwner: WLT owns monetary policy/application/accounting; upstream domains provide governed identities/evidence only.

tasks.objective: Replace floating/global onboarding monetary policy with exact minor-units, operator-context-scoped, versioned, audited policy.
tasks.currentProblem: Onboarding fee uses float64 and singleton id=1 with no visible context/version audit authority.
tasks.requiredChange: Persist exact minor units/currency/context/effective version/audit and migrate existing values without silent rounding.
tasks.targetState: Every onboarding fee decision is exact, scoped and reproducible by policy version.
tasks.action: Change StoreOnboardingFeePolicy from float64 Amount to integer minor units with an explicit currency, replace the 'WHERE id = 1' singleton with an operator-context-scoped versioned row, add an append-only policy audit trail, and forward-migrate existing float values with an exact-representation check that holds ambiguous rows for finance review instead of rounding them.
mustNotChange: Do not silently round legacy float values.
Do not keep a cross-context singleton as authority.
Do not allow unaudited policy replacement.
acceptanceCriteria: No float/current global cross-context monetary authority.
Ambiguous historical values are explicitly held for migration/review.
tasks.rollback: Preserve historical policy versions; never restore float/global authority.

tasks.objective: Prove subscription activation/renewal/compensation has one captured-payment and one refund/accounting lineage.
tasks.currentProblem: Commercial lifecycle is financially material but package had no unit proving exactly-once payment/refund/accounting coupling.
tasks.requiredChange: Bind lifecycle transitions to immutable purchase/payment identity, canonical ledger and original-source compensation semantics.
tasks.targetState: Entitlement and money effects converge exactly once under duplicate/concurrent/unknown results.
tasks.action: Bind ActivateSubscriptionLifecycleGoverned, RenewSubscriptionLifecycleGoverned and CancelSubscriptionLifecycleGoverned to a captured payment session identity and a canonical ledger posting, route compensation through the original payment source, and add uniqueness plus replay conflict handling so a repeated lifecycle call cannot produce a second entitlement or a second monetary effect.
mustNotChange: Do not activate from client-reported success.
Do not refund to an unrelated source.
Do not duplicate entitlement on replay.
acceptanceCriteria: One purchase identity maps to one financial/entitlement effect.
Compensation follows original source and unknown result reconciliation.
tasks.rollback: Use governed compensation/reconciliation, not destructive row rollback.

tasks.objective: Make promotion funding trusted-context/evidence bound and accounting-backed at commit/reversal.
tasks.currentProblem: Promotion funding accepts caller-provided context and monetary transition state without proven canonical ledger lineage.
tasks.requiredChange: Derive context from trusted boundary, conserve funding split and post commit/reversal through idempotent canonical accounting.
tasks.targetState: Promotion funding cannot forge scope/amount or create off-ledger value.
tasks.action: Replace OperatorContextAssertion's acceptance of payload/header operator context with resolution from the trusted server boundary, conserve the funding split against the canonical discount total inside Reserve, and post one balanced idempotent canonical ledger effect on Commit and on Reverse while leaving completed reservation rows immutable.
mustNotChange: Do not trust payload/header operator context.
Do not let discount funding exceed canonical discount.
Do not mutate committed/reversed history in place.
acceptanceCriteria: Commit/reversal each have balanced exactly-once ledger lineage.
tasks.rollback: Reverse through canonical ledger/state transition only.

tasks.objective: Bind pricing money inputs to authoritative sources/policies, enforce bounds and reproduce exact quote composition in PaymentAllocation.
tasks.currentProblem: Pricing quote accepts unit-price/fee money inputs; current checkout snapshot improvement does not by itself prove authoritative origin or WLT allocation binding.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace each component to governed source, enforce integer/bounds/expiry/version/hash and bind the resulting quote composition to payment allocation.
tasks.targetState: Checkout/payment cannot alter price/fee/discount composition after canonical quote snapshot.
tasks.action: Make CalculateQuote resolve every QuoteInputLine money component from a governed authoritative source instead of the caller, enforce integer minor-unit bounds and non-negative totals, stamp the quote with a version, expiry and content hash, and bind that hash to the PaymentAllocation so checkout and payment cannot diverge from the canonical snapshot.
mustNotChange: Do not revert canonical minor-unit checkout snapshots.
Do not trust client-entered price components.
Do not allow quote/payment totals to diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: Quote hash/version/expiry and PaymentAllocation conserve exact total.
tasks.rollback: Reject stale/invalid quotes and regenerate; never fall back to legacy monetary fields.
